payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-10-24: (a) shipped in PR #3743 (merged 22 Oct 2026, commit 09c81c94c): any source whose document_status is outdated is removed before every answer route (src/lib/rag/superseded-evidence.ts); review_due and unknown sources stay. The owner kept it on 24 Oct 2026 and declined the wider version in PR #3700, which would also have dropped withdrawn and past-expiry sources (docs/decisions/2026-10-24-superseded-sources-stay-out-of-answers.md). Branch claude/project-thread-d92wad also applies the filter to Clinical Ask (src/lib/clinical-ask/indexed-evidence.ts). The #3743 canary pair is not recorded (docs/rag-behaviour/canary-ledger.md). (b) remains unbuilt. PRIOR DETAIL: UPDATE 2026-10-21 (answer safety hardening thread, offline): tier-rule tests added to tests/australian-source-priority.test.ts (WA ahead of national ahead of other states ahead of supplementary at equal relevance, relevance always wins across bands, supplementary padding dropped once two Australian documents suffice). Both owner additions remain unbuilt: (a) outdated sources are only penalised in rag-second-stage.ts and warned about in the sealed src/lib/source-governance.ts, so they can still carry a claim; (b) buildSourceConflictSection (src/lib/rag/source-conflict-section.ts) only compares uploaded_local with australian_public, and uploaded_local retrieval is fail-closed (#9V1TJ5), so a WA versus national public disagreement is never disclosed. Both are answer-behaviour changes: RAG notice, canary pair and hazard reseal needed; plan sent to the owner 2026-10-21. PRIOR DETAIL: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-25: confirmed the existing tier order (WA validated > Australian national > other Australian state > supplementary, within a relevance band) and asked for two additions: a superseded source is never used as evidence, and a clinically material WA-vs-national disagreement is disclosed with both sources shown. Found 2026-09-25: outdated sources are currently KEPT and shown with a danger-severity OUTDATED warning (src/lib/source-governance.ts), and authority conflict in source-authority-registry.ts means publisher-metadata mismatch, not clinical disagreement. Both additions change retrieval/answer behaviour: flag before editing and run a live canary pair (owner approval, about USD 1-2) around the change. A rule already exists: src/lib/australian-source-priority.ts ranks wa_validated < australian_national < australian_state < supplementary WITHIN a relevance band, and tracks authorityConflictCount. Only 3 eval cases touch conflict/superseded sources. Owner recommendation (2026-09-25): confirm that order, add (a) superseded versions never used as evidence and (b) disclose both sources when WA and national disagree on something clinically material. Next action: owner confirms the rule, then add conflict/currentness/attribution cases. Ranking is RAG-protected: flag before editing and require a canary pair for any ordering change.
